{{External|rs|rsc|dw=Gold Bar}} {{Infobox Item |name = Gold bar |image = [[File:Gold bar.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = It's a bar of gold. |value = 300 |weight = 1.814 |respawn = 1500 |exchange = Yes |id = 2357 }} [[File:Gold bar detail.png|120px|left]] A '''gold bar''' is a [[bar]] of refined gold created through the [[Smithing]] [[skill]] at level 40 by using a [[gold ore]] with a [[furnace]], or by casting [[Superheat Item]] on it. By default, this gives 22.5 Smithing [[experience]] per bar, but if the [[goldsmith gauntlets]] from the [[Family Crest]] [[quest]] are worn, the experience given is boosted to 56.2. The primary use of gold bars is to create [[jewellery]] through the [[Crafting]] skill. To craft gold bars into jewellery, players must use a gold bar on a furnace with the proper [[mould]] in their [[inventory]]. If players wish to craft jewellery with [[gems]] inset, they must also have the respective cut gems. {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center;" |+Gold [[jewellery]] |- !{{SCP|Crafting}} level !Product!!XP !Alch value !GE Price !Profit/loss |- |5||{{plink|Gold ring}}||15 |{{Coins|{{Alch|Gold ring}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Gold ring}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Gold ring}}-{{GEP|Gold bar}}}} |- |6||{{plink|Gold necklace}}||20 |{{Coins|{{Alch|Gold necklace}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Gold necklace}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Gold necklace}}-{{GEP|Gold bar}}}} |- |7||{{plink|Gold bracelet}}||25 |{{Coins|{{Alch|Gold bracelet}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Gold bracelet}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Gold bracelet}}-{{GEP|Gold bar}}}} |- |8||{{plink|Gold amulet (u)}}||30 |{{Coins|{{Alch|Gold amulet (u)}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Gold amulet (u)}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Gold amulet (u)}}-{{GEP|Gold bar}}}} |- |42||{{plink|Gold tiara}}||35 |{{Coins|{{Alch|Gold tiara}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Gold tiara}}}} |{{Coins|{{GEP|Gold tiara}}-{{GEP|Gold bar}}}} |} Apart from jewellery, gold bars can be used to create [[gold helmet]]s, used in the [[Between a Rock...]] quest, [[gold bowl]]s which are used in the [[Legends' Quest]], and the [[enchanted bar]] used in [[Monkey Madness I]]. Through questing, a player can obtain one gold bar upon completion of the [[Goblin Diplomacy]] quest, two from the [[Waterfall Quest]], and two from [[The Dig Site]] quest. Using the [[Telekinetic Grab]] spell, one can obtain a gold bar and a gold ore from the basement of [[Varrock west bank]] or gold bars in the [[Corsair Cove Dungeon]] (south of the bank vault). The northernmost section of the cave at [[Corsair Cove]] (accessible after [[Dragon Slayer I]]) has an additional three gold bar spawns available without the need of Telekinetic Grab. ==Creation== Standard= {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 40 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 22.5 |members = No |ticks = 5 |ticksnote = Make-All option available |facilities = Furnace |mat1 = Gold ore |output1 = Gold bar |output1subtxt = Regular furnace }} |-| Blast Furnace= {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 40 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 22.5 |members = Yes |ticks = 11 |ticksnote = Multiple bars are completed at once |facilities = Blast Furnace |mat1 = Gold ore |output1 = Gold bar |output1subtxt = Blast Furnace }} |-| Superheat= {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 40 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 22.5 |skill2 = Magic |skill2lvl = 43 |skill2boostable = Yes |skill2exp = 53 |members = No |ticks = 3 |mat1 = Gold ore |mat3 = Nature rune |mat4 = Fire rune |mat4quantity = 4 |output1 = Gold bar |output1subtxt = Superheat }} ==Smithing Table== {{Smithing/Gold bar}} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Gold bar}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Gold bar}} ===Spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Gold bar|location=[[Varrock]] -
